subject: arcadeCabinet
pitch:
Category: Object.
Subject: 1980s arcade cabinet.
Style: synthwave.

requests.what: Marquee lettering: the title NEON RACER in chunky retro block letters, MAGENTA with a CYAN outline and a SUN-orange underline stripe, glowing, plus a small chrome racing-car silhouette at each end of the light box.

Attract-mode image on the CRT: a synthwave sunset with SUN striped sun on the horizon, a PURPLE/MAGENTA perspective grid floor, a CYAN road with dashed centre line and a tiny car, as thin glowing layered parts sitting on the screen; plus 'INSERT COIN' text row at the bottom.
Screen bezel details: a curved-glass highlight corner on the screen, four small chrome corner screws, and a thin CYAN glowing inner frame line.
Two speaker grilles flanking the marquee base: rows of small round holes or slats in BLACK on BODY_DARK with MAGENTA trim rings (a pair, left at +x, right at -x).

Control panel detail: player 1 START and player 2 START small lit buttons with labels, a CYAN grid-line pattern etched on the PANEL surface, chrome mounting screws, and a MAGENTA neon edge strip along the front lip.
Coin door: two coin mechanisms with chrome slot plates, glowing RED and YELLOW coin-return buttons, 'INSERT COIN' small label, a CYAN-lit coin return cup and four screws.
Neon T-molding: slim glowing MAGENTA tube strips hugging the front and top edges of both side panels, with CYAN tube strips along the control-panel step, and end caps.
Back of the cabinet: ventilation slots near the top, a power cord plug and cable looping down to the floor, a warning label, and a ribbon of PURPLE cables to the monitor.
Underglow: a CYAN glowing light strip along the kick plate bottom and a soft MAGENTA floor-glow disc beneath the cabinet front, sized to the cabinet footprint.
Retro-futurist top ornaments: a small CYAN/MAGENTA glowing chevron fin pair on the marquee roof corners and a tiny antenna-style light beacon.

Synthwave side art on both side panels (parts sideL and sideR): a BODY_DARK field with a big SUN-orange striped setting sun, MAGENTA and CYAN diagonal speed stripes sweeping to the rear, and a PURPLE perspective grid at the bottom.
Control panel top printed in PANEL with MAGENTA and CYAN geometric zigzag borders and faint player-zone outlines around the joystick and buttons.
Lower front panel painted in BODY with a gradient of MAGENTA to PURPLE horizontal stripes and a faded checker band.

calls.reasoning:
I'm designing a static synthwave arcade cabinet module with a realistic upright shape — base box, sloped control panel, recessed monitor bezel, marquee, side art, coin door, kick plate — and planning out the required exports like meta, REQUESTS, STAGE2, and the default function.

Working through the side profile geometry, I'm extruding the cabinet's silhouette as a polygon in the z-y plane (front-to-back by height), plotting coordinates for the lower body, the angled control panel, the recessed screen area, the marquee top, and the tapered back panel to get that classic cabinet contour.

I'm figuring out how to model the sloped control panel as a rotated box positioned between the body and screen, calculating its center point and tilt angle from the slope between the two profile vertices.

I'm positioning a recessed monitor screen on the front face, giving it a flat emissive-style panel that could render a glow effect.

I'm planning the rest of the cabinet details: a deep indigo glowing screen with black bezel framing, a magenta marquee panel reading "NEON RACER," plus joystick, buttons, coin door, speaker grille, T-molding trim in cyan/magenta, and side art panels with a sun-and-grid motif.

Naming the side panels, adding cyan neon edge strips along the front, small foot boxes, and a dark kickplate, then setting up the full color palette and a reusable box helper function with glow effects imported from a kit module.

Now I'm working out joystick placement on the tilted control panel — computing the panel's surface height and normal direction at that position by rotating the up vector about the x-axis, so the joystick sits flush and angled correctly on the sloped surface.

I'm also setting up side panel geometry mirrored at both edges, a marquee glow plane near the top with housing dimensions for the cabinet interior, and planning how parts get named for texture mapping.

Now I'm stacking the lower and upper core boxes, the marquee housing, and adding a screen bezel with glowing screen surface at the front. Then I'll compile the full list of requested mesh parts.

I'm working out how the extrude side faces map to outline coordinates, with x representing the z-axis position and y the height, so I can apply paint consistently across the side walls using those coordinates.

Writing side paint logic... designing a sun motif, diagonal speed stripes, and a perspective grid, restricted to ±x-facing surfaces, with the control panel box using uv coordinates masked by the top-facing normal.

Still figuring out the control panel markings...

Now I'm mapping the front panel: a gradient from magenta to purple along the vertical axis, with striped bands and a checker pattern near the base, plus positioning the coin door opening within that face.

I'm now planning the code edits needed: adding paint color definitions near the STAGE2 declaration, updating the extrude color assignment for side naming, and adjusting the control panel box geometry.
